provenance: Stone's Week 13 game plan, runner-ready call sheet (section 59), approved by the user as APPROVED_WEEK_13_PLAN and frozen verbatim before any Week 13 draw under kernel 2013.9. Plan provenance as supplied: Stone Week 13 plan after Jacksonville's canonical 38-6 Week 12 loss at Houston. The central correction is game-flow discipline after Jacksonville abandoned a productive run game. The plan retains the internal protection structure, adds a small 22-personnel short-yardage/red-zone package, preserves Harris outside and Poyer at nickel, and restores Bouye as the first outside reserve only if medical clearance is communicated (it is: his Week 11 injury cleared at its projected return, November 26, under the rule every club gets).
